comments.author: conceptofmind
comments.body:
@dmahan93 noticed that embeds are not fed to logits. This may be the issue.

Logits takes in x:
```python
        # final norm

        embeds = self.norm(x)

        if return_only_embedding:
            return embeds

        # to logits

        logits = self.to_logits(x)
```
Should it be logits takes in embeds?
```python
        # final norm

        embeds = self.norm(x)

        if return_only_embedding:
            return embeds

        # to logits

        logits = self.to_logits(embeds)
```
Thank you,

Enrico
